categories.name: wallet
categories.evidence: Carries the Wallet label and modifies wallet setup error handling and database cleanup in src/wallet/wallet.cpp.
categories.rationale: Fixes an unhandled std::runtime_error exception that crashes bitcoin-qt when external signer setup fails, and cleans up orphaned wallet directories that block subsequent creation attempts. Author shows reproduction steps where invalid signer setup causes 'terminate called after throwing an instance of std::runtime_error' on master, while leaving an empty database that causes retry attempts to fail with 'Database already exists'.
